attempts.summary: Configured a routed transit-firewall-pair: node1 (VyOS) fronts node3 on lan-a (10.50.10.0/24), node2 (OPNsense) fronts node4 on lan-b (10.50.20.0/24), routers peer on a transit network (10.50.30.0/24). Both routers default-deny forwarded traffic; a narrow allow was added on each (VyOS forward filter rule + OPNsense pf pass rule) permitting only TCP/8080 from lan-a to node4 (10.50.20.13), plus established/related return traffic. A systemd-managed HTTP service was created on node4:8080 with firewalld opened for that port. Verified node3 reaches node4:8080 via HTTP while ping and other ports between the networks remain blocked in both directions. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery of addressing, routes, firewall rules, and the HTTP data path after each restart.
